name: SF Mental Health & Substance Use Provider Directory
description: San Francisco's official directory of mental health and substance use disorder treatment providers, maintained by the Department of Public Health Behavioral Health Services.
fullDescription: San Francisco's official directory of mental health and substance use disorder treatment providers, maintained by the Department of Public Health Behavioral Health Services.
whatTheyOffer:
- Mental health plan provider and clinician directories (reviewed monthly)
- Substance use services (Drug Medi-Cal) provider directories
- Shows addresses, services, languages, and whether providers accept new members
- Available in English, Spanish, Chinese, Vietnamese, Russian, and Tagalog
- Free paper copies and large print on request
howToGetIt: Download the directories online, or call the 24/7 Behavioral Health Access Line at 1-888-246-3333 or 415-255-3737 (TDD 711) for help finding services and scheduling assessments. Request printed copies at BHSMemberServices@sfdph.org.
keywords: San Francisco, mental health, substance use, provider directory, therapist, counselor, drug treatment, alcohol, psychiatrist, Medi-Cal, clinic
